study: Brochier L, one recording, held validation originals
metrics: First six entries are mean absolute errors on raw sensor changes in ADC counts. The last is the arithmetic mean of six fit-scale-normalized errors (dimensionless).
channels: Four grip sensor channels (0–3), pull sensor (4), Hall sensor associated with object travel (5). Travel in millimetres and force in physical units are uncalibrated here.
grain: Mean absolute error across the scored issue times of each original trial, then the arithmetic mean across scored originals. The common frozen target_valid flag alone determines row exclusion.
paired_difference: Comparator MAE minus candidate MAE. A positive difference favours the candidate.

bootstrap.estimator: Paired percentile interval, linear quantiles at 0.025 and 0.975; common draws across methods, channels and seeds.
bootstrap.scope: Conditional on this recording, observed trial mix and the fitted models. Secondary intervals are descriptive and unadjusted for multiple comparisons.

primary_rule: On Hall count changes the branch must have lower MAE than clock, its own substitution, linear, persist and velocity. The lower 95% paired bound must also exceed zero against clock and its own substitution. All conditions must hold in both separately fitted seeds.
domain: Within-recording offline forecast association. Both seeds score the same validation trials. Trial resampling does not quantify between-day or between-animal uncertainty, serial dependence across trials, clinical utility or biological causation.
